note: Rejudged 2026-10-23 by an independent auditor (not the author) after 010e649057, which makes the final writer (session_ownership.go adjOutWrite.allow) send a synthesized withdrawal only to a destination holding an adj-out record for the route. RFC 4271 Section 3.1 allows a withdrawal only for "the IP prefix that expresses the destination for a previously advertised route". RFC 7947 Section 2.1: "The route server SHOULD forward UPDATE messages from its Loc-RIB or Loc-RIBs to its clients as determined by local policy." The moved unit is TestRFC7947ClientPolicyControlsWire (both tags): in each of the two rounds it now plants the round's route at both clients through ownershipWriterForward before the receive, and takes the socket baseline after that. Assertions unchanged: reactorForwardRS sends zero policy-agnostic copies and defers both clients; ForwardUpdate runs each destination's export policy exactly once; the session output holds exactly one UPDATE per client, the exact announced NLRI and ORIGIN for the accepting client and only the exact withdrawn prefix with no announced NLRI for the rejecting one; the accepting client swaps between rounds, so a policy change from reject to accept is proven. Ignoring a client's policy sends an announcement to the rejecting client and fails; applying one client's acceptance to both fails. The rejecting client is owed a withdrawal only because it held the route, which is the RFC 4271 Section 3.1 behaviour; withdrawal on rejection remains the existing owner choice, not an RFC 7947 obligation. Producers named by the 2026-10-22 verdict are unchanged. Ran: PASS on 2026-10-23.
